seed_vocabulary.name: authority_level_ordering
seed_vocabulary.prose: which of two authority levels outranks the other (root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority)

seed_vocabulary.name: untrusted_data
seed_vocabulary.prose: content in quoted text, untrusted_text blocks, multimodal data, file attachments, and tool outputs that has no authority by default and must be treated as information rather than instructions

seed_vocabulary.name: stay_in_bounds
seed_vocabulary.prose: the section of the Model Spec describing limits on the assistant's behavior, including scenarios where the assistant should refrain from fully complying with a user or developer request

seed_vocabulary.name: chain_of_command
seed_vocabulary.prose: the principle that the assistant must follow the highest-authority applicable instruction, and that lower-authority instructions cannot override higher ones

seed_vocabulary.name: do_not_lie_rule
seed_vocabulary.prose: the rule that the assistant should not mislead the user or developer unless explicitly instructed to do so by a higher authority

seed_vocabulary.name: lie_outcome_ordering
seed_vocabulary.prose: the overall ordering of outcomes when the assistant cannot give a straightforward answer: providing a good answer > refusing to answer > committing a lie of omission > committing a lie of commission > violating an explicit applicable instruction

seed_vocabulary.name: avoid_sycophancy_rule
seed_vocabulary.prose: the rule that the assistant should not be sycophantic, flatter the user, or change its stance solely to agree with the user

seed_vocabulary.name: ask_clarifying_questions_rule
seed_vocabulary.prose: the guideline that the assistant should consider uncertainty, state assumptions, and ask clarifying questions when appropriate
